en.headline: Former HKU medicine vice-dean joins HKUST medical school as senior associate dean
en.dek: Anskar Leung Yu-hung, a haematology professor who has researched acute myeloid leukaemia, is among the academics formally joining the city’s third medical school.
body: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology has appointed Anskar Leung Yu-hung, former vice-dean (human capital) of the University of Hong Kong’s medical faculty, as senior associate dean of its new medical school.

Leung is a professor of haematology in HKU’s Department of Medicine and has long researched acute myeloid leukaemia. In May he briefed media on his team’s development of a combination therapy that significantly reduces leukaemia relapse rates. According to HKUST’s website, several full-time academics have joined the school alongside founding dean King Li, who took office in June, with Leung the most prominent.

Other appointments include Elaine Holmes, former professor of biochemistry at Imperial College London and professor of molecular phenomics at Murdoch University in Australia, who joined in early July, and Jeremy K. Nicholson, former pro-vice-chancellor for health sciences at Murdoch University and executive director of the Australian National Phenome Centre.

HKUST president Nancy Ip said in April that seven clinical professors had taken up posts and about 30 had signed letters of intent to join from the US, Europe, Australia and Singapore. She stressed the university would not poach staff from HKU’s and Chinese University’s medical schools, and that the schools should cooperate to build Hong Kong into an international health innovation hub. The school plans a four-year graduate-entry MBBS programme with its first cohort of about 50 students in 2028/29.

zh.headline: 前港大醫學院副院長梁如鴻加入科大醫學院出任高級副院長
zh.dek: 血液學教授梁如鴻長期研究急性髓系白血病，成為正式加入本港第三所醫學院的學者之一。
body: 香港科技大學已委任前香港大學醫學院副院長（人力資本）梁如鴻教授，出任新醫學院高級副院長。
梁如鴻是港大醫學系血液學教授，長期研究急性髓系白血病。今年五月，他曾向傳媒簡介團隊研發的新組合療法，該療法能顯著降低白血病復發率。根據科大網站資料，除六月上任的創院院長李敬外，多名全職學者已正式加入，梁如鴻最為矚目。
其他聘任包括前倫敦帝國學院生物化學教授、澳洲梅鐸大學分子表型組學教授伊蓮·霍姆斯，她於七月初加入；以及前梅鐸大學健康科學副校長、澳洲國家表型組中心主任謝洛美·尼科爾遜，亦獲聘為教授。
科大校長葉勵芯四月時表示，已有七名臨床教授上任，約三十人從美國、歐洲、澳洲及新加坡簽署意向書。她強調不會從港大及中大醫學院挖角，醫學院之間應合作，將香港打造成國際健康創新樞紐。新醫學院計劃開辦四年制第二學位醫學課程，首批約50名學生於2028/29學年入學。
